# GMA Entertainment
>The official entertainment site of GMA Network - Get exclusive access to the latest celebrity and showbiz news plus updates on your favorite Kapuso shows.

## Homepage of GMA Entertainment
- [GMA Entertainment | Kapuso Shows & Celebrity News](/entertainment/): Explore showbiz news, videos, photos, and updates from your favorite Kapuso stars.

## Latest on GMA Entertainment
- [Philippine Showbiz News & Updates | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/showbiznews/): Get trending celebrity stories, exclusive interviews, and showbiz highlights.
- [Kapuso Artist Profiles & Bios | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/kapusoprofiles/): View detailed profiles and multimedia of GMA Network celebrities.
- [Kapuso Shorts & Viral Clips | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/kapusoshorts/): Watch short, engaging videos and reels of Kapuso stars and programs.
- [Celebrity Videos & Episode Highlights | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/videos/): Access exclusive videos, episode teasers, and behind-the-scenes content.
- [Kapuso Celebrity Photo Galleries | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/photos/): Browse photos of Kapuso events, artists, and special moments.
- [Fun Kapuso Quizzes & Trivia | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/quizzes/): Test your knowledge about GMA shows and stars with entertaining quizzes.
- [Kapuso Polls: Vote & Share Opinions | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/polls/): Join polls about celebrities and shows. See how other Kapuso fans voted.
- [Promos & Giveaways from GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/promos/): Join contests and win prizes while following your favorite Kapuso programs.
- [Kapuso Program Schedule & Airing Times | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/schedule/): Find daily and weekly broadcast schedules for all GMA shows.
- [GMA Kapuso TV & Online Shows | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/tv/): Stay updated with online exclusives and TV program content.
- [Microsites for GMA Events & Auditions | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/microsites/): Explore special sites for auditions, reality shows, and Kapuso events.
- [Sitemap | GMA Entertainment](/sitemap/): Quick access to all pages and content across GMA Entertainment.
- [Privacy Policy | GMA Entertainment](/privacypolicy/): Read about how GMA Entertainment protects your data and privacy.

## GMA Entertainment Featured Shows
- [Family Feud | TV | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/tv/family_feud/): Inihahandog ng GMA ang sikat na game show mula sa Amerika na pinusuan ng buong mundo at ngayon ay nasa Pilipinas na, ito ang Family Feud. Ang Philippine edition ng Family Feud ay pinangungunahan ng Kapuso actor at family man na si Dingdong Dantes. Araw-araw ay mapapanood ang tagisan ng galing ng celebrities sa pagsagot sa survey questions kasama ang miyembro ng kanilang pamilya. Ang Kapuso viewers ay may chance rin na manalo ng tumataginting na kalahating milyong piso linggo-linggo. Survey says tumutok sa Family Feud araw-araw, 5:40 ng hapon sa GMA. 
- [Beyond 75: The GMA 75th Anniversary Special | TV | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/tv/beyond_75/): In celebration of GMA's 75th Anniversary, the network is sharing this milestone with all our Kapuso viewers with a grand special entitled, Beyond 75: The GMA 75th Anniversary Special.' Airing on July 12, this star-studded event for GMA's Diamond Anniversary focuses on collaboration among GMA artists and some very special guests.  The grand musical special will showcase the star force of GMA talents from Entertainment, Integrated News, Public Affairs, and some of our network partners as we gather together over 200 Kapuso personalities to commemorate this momentous occasion and celebrate the exciting future that lies ahead
- [Fast Talk with Boy Abunda | TV | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/tv/fast_talk_with_boy_abunda/): Inihahandog ng GMA Network ang pinakabagong multi-platform showbiz news and talk show na Fast Talk with Boy Abunda kung saan isa-isang hihimayin ang mga pinaka-maiinit na isyu sa showbiz at mga kaabang-abang na hot seat interviews sa celebrities kasama ang tinaguriang King of Talk na si Boy Abunda. Ang naturang programa ay naglalayong maging isang credible go-to source patungkol sa lahat ng mga kaganapan sa showbiz industry. Lunes hanggang Biyernes, ihahatid ng Fast Talk with Boy Abunda ang latest showbiz updates at siksik na talakayan sa guest celebrities sa loob ng 20 minuto. Mapapanood ang Fast Talk with Boy Abunda via television broadcast sa GMA at sa iba pang digital platforms. 
- [Pulang Araw | TV | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/tv/pulang_araw/): Pulang Araw is a family drama that tells stories of courage, sacrifice, and hardships that every Filipino family has. These stories were inspired by the tales of the unsung heroes who defied the odds of World War II and the Japanese occupation of the Philippines. This is the first family drama of GMA that brings together five of the biggest stars in the country starring Barbie Forteza, Sanya Lopez, David Licauco, and Alden Richards. Together with Dennis Trillo in a very special role. Barbie plays Adelina Dela Cruz, a selfless Filipina ready to sacrifice everything to protect her family. Sanya plays Teresita Borromeo, who together with her sister Adelina, will rise to fame as a Vaudeville performer in the Philippines. However, Teresita will be forced to serve as a comfort woman during the Japanese occupation. David portrays the reserved Japanese man named Hiroshi Tanaka, and Alden plays Eduardo Dela Cruz, a brave and determined young Filipino man who will do everything to fight for his country. Meanwhile, Dennis takes on his first villain role as a ruthless Japanese soldier named Col. Yuta Saitoh. Pulang Araw is a primetime offering of GMA Entertainment Group headed by Senior Vice President for Entertainment Group Lilybeth G. Rasonable, Vice President for Drama Cheryl Ching-Sy, Assistant Vice President for Drama Helen Rose Sese, Program Manager Edlyn Tallada-Abuel, and Executive Producer Shielyn Atienza. Under the helm of brilliant director Dominic Zapata and award-winning writer Suzette Doctolero, Pulang Araw airs on GMA Prime beginning July 29. 
- [Pinoy Big Brother Celebrity Collab Edition | TV | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/tv/pinoy_big_brother_celebrity_collab_edition/): The iconic Bahay ni Kuya is now open for its new season called 'Pinoy Big Brother Celebrity Collab Edition.' The show marks another exciting collaboration between two content leaders in the Philippine entertainment industry, GMA Network and ABS-CBN Studios. Sparkle and Star Magic artists live together inside Bahay ni Kuya, isolated from the outside world. The housemates are continuously monitored during their stay in the house by live television cameras and personal audio microphones. Serving as hosts for its new season are Bianca Gonzalez, Gabbi Garcia, Robi Domingo, Kim Chiu, Melai Cantiveros-Francisco, Enchong Dee, Alexa Ilacad, and Mavy Legaspi. Watch out for BIG surprises on 'Pinoy Big Brother Celebrity Collab Edition.' 
- [Widows' War | TV | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/tv/widows_war/): 'Widows' War' is the newest murder mystery drama series on GMA Network, top-billed by A-list Kapuso actresses Bea Alonzo and Carla Abellana. The story will revolve around the lives of best friends Sam (Bea) and George (Carla), who treat each other as sisters, but later on, their friendship will be ruined and they will find love. Unbeknownst to the two, they are marrying two men who belong to the same family, the Palacios. Completing the star-studded cast of the 2024 series are Tonton Gutierrez, Jeric Gonzales, Juancho Trivino, Jackie Lou Blanco, Lito Pimentel, Timmy Cruz, Rita Daniela, Royce Cabrera, Lovely Rivero, James Graham, Charlie Flemming, Matthew Uy, and Jean Garcia. With the special participation of actors Benjamin Alves and Rafael Rosell. The concept and story were from the same creative team that brought viewers the hit murder mystery drama series 'Widows' Web' and 'Royal Blood.' The series is under the helm of Direk Zig Dulay. Catch the world premiere of 'Widows' War,' on July 1, 2024, on GMA Prime.
- [It's Showtime | TV | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/tv/its_showtime/): 'It's Showtime' is the longest-running noontime variety show of ABS-CBN that has now found its new home under GMA Network's main channel, GMA 7. Hosted by Vice Ganda, Anne Curtis, Vhong Navarro, Jhong Hilario, Karylle, Teddy Corpuz, Jugs Jugueta, Ryan Bang, Amy Perez, Kim Chiu, Ogie Alcasid, Ion Perez, Jackie Gonzaga, MC, Lassy and Cianne Dominguez, 'It's Showtime' brings together people from all walks of life with their fun gimmicks, witty catchphrases, and distinct personalities that will surely make your afternoons more exciting and full of good vibes.
- [Encantadia Chronicles: Sang'gre | TV | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/tv/encantadia_chronicles_sanggre/): Mula 2005 hanggang sa kasalukuyan, nananatiling buhay ang mahika ng 'Encantadia' sa puso ng bawat Pilipino. At ngayong 2025, isang bagong kabanata ang magbubukas—ang Encantadia Chronicles: 'Sang'gre.' Kilalanin si Terra—ang itinakdang tagapagligtas—na bibigyang-buhay ni Bianca Umali, kasama ang bagong henerasyon ng mga Sang'gre: sina Adamus (Kelvin Miranda), Deia (Angel Guardian), at Flamarra (Faith Da Silva). Saksihan ang kanilang kamangha-manghang pakikipagsapalaran at tunggalian laban sa Reyna ng Nyebe, si Mitena, na gagampanan ni Rhian Ramos. Magbabalik sina Pirena (Glaiza de Castro), Danaya (Sanya Lopez), Alena (Gabbi Garcia), at Amihan (Kylie Padilla) upang ipagpatuloy ang kanilang kwento at maging gabay sa bagong henerasyon ng mga tagapangalaga ng brilyante. Kasama rin sa maningning na hanay ng mga tauhan sina Gabby Eigenmann (Zaur), Jon Lucas (Daron), Jamie Wilson (Ednu), Bianca Manalo (Olgana), Luis Hontiveros (Soldarius), Shuvee Etrata (Veshdita), Vito at Kiel Gueco (Mantuk at Tukman), Therese Malvar (Dina), Vince Maristela (Akiro), Pamela Prinster (Cami), Manilyn Reynes (Mona Reyes), Boboy Garrovillo (Javier Reyes), Sherilyn Reyes (Katrina Salvador), at Ricky Davao (Gob. Emil Salvador). Abangan ang Encantadia Chronicles: SANG'GRE ngayong Hunyo sa GMA Prime.
- [Mommy Dearest | TV | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/tv/mommy_dearest/): Mommy Dearest tells the story of two mothers, Emma and Olive, and their love for a child named Mookie. Growing up, Mookie was sickly and it was up to her mother, Olive, and her love, to take care of her and maker her better. Emma, on the other hand, comes into their lives as a stay-out maid and becomes Mookie's confidant and best friend, only for Olive to try and put a stop to it. Mommy Dearest serves as the reunion between Camille Prats, who plays Olive, and Shayne Sava, who stars as Mookie, in an Afternoon Prime series. Katrina Halili, who stars as Emma, also reunites with co-Starstruck alumna Shayne and Dion Ignacio. The series also stars Prince Carlos, Winwyn Marquez, Amy Austria, Mel Martinez, Riel Lomadilla, and Viveika Ravanes.
- [Abot Kamay Na Pangarap | TV | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/tv/abot_kamay_na_pangarap/): This September 2022, GMA-7 offers the most inspiring drama on Philippine television with 'Abot Kamay Na Pangarap'. The new drama series stars seasoned actress Carmina Villarroel and one of the fastest-rising Kapuso stars Jillian Ward. 'Abot Kamay Na Pangarap' tells the life story of an illiterate mother named Lyneth (Carmina Villarroel) and her intelligent daughter and youngest neuro surgeon in the Philippines named Analyn (Jillian Ward). Aside from the two actresses, the new Kapuso serye also stars Richard Yap who will play the role of Robert Tanyag, a passionate doctor. What is the true connection of Robert to Lyneth and Analyn? The story of this heartwarming series progresses as the two help and support each other in every struggle that comes their way. Will they be able to reach their goals and dreams through their amazing mother-daughter tandem? Watch out for another afternoon serye that will inspire you to be patient and to not stop in pursuing your dreams for yourself.

## GMA Entertainment Featured Shows
- [Family Feud | TV | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/tv/family_feud/): Inihahandog ng GMA ang sikat na game show mula sa Amerika na pinusuan ng buong mundo at ngayon ay nasa Pilipinas na, ito ang Family Feud. Ang Philippine edition ng Family Feud ay pinangungunahan ng Kapuso actor at family man na si Dingdong Dantes. Araw-araw ay mapapanood ang tagisan ng galing ng celebrities sa pagsagot sa survey questions kasama ang miyembro ng kanilang pamilya. Ang Kapuso viewers ay may chance rin na manalo ng tumataginting na kalahating milyong piso linggo-linggo. Survey says tumutok sa Family Feud araw-araw, 5:40 ng hapon sa GMA. 
- [Beyond 75: The GMA 75th Anniversary Special | TV | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/tv/beyond_75/): In celebration of GMA's 75th Anniversary, the network is sharing this milestone with all our Kapuso viewers with a grand special entitled, Beyond 75: The GMA 75th Anniversary Special.' Airing on July 12, this star-studded event for GMA's Diamond Anniversary focuses on collaboration among GMA artists and some very special guests.  The grand musical special will showcase the star force of GMA talents from Entertainment, Integrated News, Public Affairs, and some of our network partners as we gather together over 200 Kapuso personalities to commemorate this momentous occasion and celebrate the exciting future that lies ahead
- [Fast Talk with Boy Abunda | TV | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/tv/fast_talk_with_boy_abunda/): Inihahandog ng GMA Network ang pinakabagong multi-platform showbiz news and talk show na Fast Talk with Boy Abunda kung saan isa-isang hihimayin ang mga pinaka-maiinit na isyu sa showbiz at mga kaabang-abang na hot seat interviews sa celebrities kasama ang tinaguriang King of Talk na si Boy Abunda. Ang naturang programa ay naglalayong maging isang credible go-to source patungkol sa lahat ng mga kaganapan sa showbiz industry. Lunes hanggang Biyernes, ihahatid ng Fast Talk with Boy Abunda ang latest showbiz updates at siksik na talakayan sa guest celebrities sa loob ng 20 minuto. Mapapanood ang Fast Talk with Boy Abunda via television broadcast sa GMA at sa iba pang digital platforms. 
- [Pulang Araw | TV | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/tv/pulang_araw/): Pulang Araw is a family drama that tells stories of courage, sacrifice, and hardships that every Filipino family has. These stories were inspired by the tales of the unsung heroes who defied the odds of World War II and the Japanese occupation of the Philippines. This is the first family drama of GMA that brings together five of the biggest stars in the country starring Barbie Forteza, Sanya Lopez, David Licauco, and Alden Richards. Together with Dennis Trillo in a very special role. Barbie plays Adelina Dela Cruz, a selfless Filipina ready to sacrifice everything to protect her family. Sanya plays Teresita Borromeo, who together with her sister Adelina, will rise to fame as a Vaudeville performer in the Philippines. However, Teresita will be forced to serve as a comfort woman during the Japanese occupation. David portrays the reserved Japanese man named Hiroshi Tanaka, and Alden plays Eduardo Dela Cruz, a brave and determined young Filipino man who will do everything to fight for his country. Meanwhile, Dennis takes on his first villain role as a ruthless Japanese soldier named Col. Yuta Saitoh. Pulang Araw is a primetime offering of GMA Entertainment Group headed by Senior Vice President for Entertainment Group Lilybeth G. Rasonable, Vice President for Drama Cheryl Ching-Sy, Assistant Vice President for Drama Helen Rose Sese, Program Manager Edlyn Tallada-Abuel, and Executive Producer Shielyn Atienza. Under the helm of brilliant director Dominic Zapata and award-winning writer Suzette Doctolero, Pulang Araw airs on GMA Prime beginning July 29. 
- [Pinoy Big Brother Celebrity Collab Edition | TV | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/tv/pinoy_big_brother_celebrity_collab_edition/): The iconic Bahay ni Kuya is now open for its new season called 'Pinoy Big Brother Celebrity Collab Edition.' The show marks another exciting collaboration between two content leaders in the Philippine entertainment industry, GMA Network and ABS-CBN Studios. Sparkle and Star Magic artists live together inside Bahay ni Kuya, isolated from the outside world. The housemates are continuously monitored during their stay in the house by live television cameras and personal audio microphones. Serving as hosts for its new season are Bianca Gonzalez, Gabbi Garcia, Robi Domingo, Kim Chiu, Melai Cantiveros-Francisco, Enchong Dee, Alexa Ilacad, and Mavy Legaspi. Watch out for BIG surprises on 'Pinoy Big Brother Celebrity Collab Edition.' 
- [Widows' War | TV | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/tv/widows_war/): 'Widows' War' is the newest murder mystery drama series on GMA Network, top-billed by A-list Kapuso actresses Bea Alonzo and Carla Abellana. The story will revolve around the lives of best friends Sam (Bea) and George (Carla), who treat each other as sisters, but later on, their friendship will be ruined and they will find love. Unbeknownst to the two, they are marrying two men who belong to the same family, the Palacios. Completing the star-studded cast of the 2024 series are Tonton Gutierrez, Jeric Gonzales, Juancho Trivino, Jackie Lou Blanco, Lito Pimentel, Timmy Cruz, Rita Daniela, Royce Cabrera, Lovely Rivero, James Graham, Charlie Flemming, Matthew Uy, and Jean Garcia. With the special participation of actors Benjamin Alves and Rafael Rosell. The concept and story were from the same creative team that brought viewers the hit murder mystery drama series 'Widows' Web' and 'Royal Blood.' The series is under the helm of Direk Zig Dulay. Catch the world premiere of 'Widows' War,' on July 1, 2024, on GMA Prime.
- [It's Showtime | TV | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/tv/its_showtime/): 'It's Showtime' is the longest-running noontime variety show of ABS-CBN that has now found its new home under GMA Network's main channel, GMA 7. Hosted by Vice Ganda, Anne Curtis, Vhong Navarro, Jhong Hilario, Karylle, Teddy Corpuz, Jugs Jugueta, Ryan Bang, Amy Perez, Kim Chiu, Ogie Alcasid, Ion Perez, Jackie Gonzaga, MC, Lassy and Cianne Dominguez, 'It's Showtime' brings together people from all walks of life with their fun gimmicks, witty catchphrases, and distinct personalities that will surely make your afternoons more exciting and full of good vibes.
- [Encantadia Chronicles: Sang'gre | TV | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/tv/encantadia_chronicles_sanggre/): Mula 2005 hanggang sa kasalukuyan, nananatiling buhay ang mahika ng 'Encantadia' sa puso ng bawat Pilipino. At ngayong 2025, isang bagong kabanata ang magbubukas—ang Encantadia Chronicles: 'Sang'gre.' Kilalanin si Terra—ang itinakdang tagapagligtas—na bibigyang-buhay ni Bianca Umali, kasama ang bagong henerasyon ng mga Sang'gre: sina Adamus (Kelvin Miranda), Deia (Angel Guardian), at Flamarra (Faith Da Silva). Saksihan ang kanilang kamangha-manghang pakikipagsapalaran at tunggalian laban sa Reyna ng Nyebe, si Mitena, na gagampanan ni Rhian Ramos. Magbabalik sina Pirena (Glaiza de Castro), Danaya (Sanya Lopez), Alena (Gabbi Garcia), at Amihan (Kylie Padilla) upang ipagpatuloy ang kanilang kwento at maging gabay sa bagong henerasyon ng mga tagapangalaga ng brilyante. Kasama rin sa maningning na hanay ng mga tauhan sina Gabby Eigenmann (Zaur), Jon Lucas (Daron), Jamie Wilson (Ednu), Bianca Manalo (Olgana), Luis Hontiveros (Soldarius), Shuvee Etrata (Veshdita), Vito at Kiel Gueco (Mantuk at Tukman), Therese Malvar (Dina), Vince Maristela (Akiro), Pamela Prinster (Cami), Manilyn Reynes (Mona Reyes), Boboy Garrovillo (Javier Reyes), Sherilyn Reyes (Katrina Salvador), at Ricky Davao (Gob. Emil Salvador). Abangan ang Encantadia Chronicles: SANG'GRE ngayong Hunyo sa GMA Prime.
- [Mommy Dearest | TV | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/tv/mommy_dearest/): Mommy Dearest tells the story of two mothers, Emma and Olive, and their love for a child named Mookie. Growing up, Mookie was sickly and it was up to her mother, Olive, and her love, to take care of her and maker her better. Emma, on the other hand, comes into their lives as a stay-out maid and becomes Mookie's confidant and best friend, only for Olive to try and put a stop to it. Mommy Dearest serves as the reunion between Camille Prats, who plays Olive, and Shayne Sava, who stars as Mookie, in an Afternoon Prime series. Katrina Halili, who stars as Emma, also reunites with co-Starstruck alumna Shayne and Dion Ignacio. The series also stars Prince Carlos, Winwyn Marquez, Amy Austria, Mel Martinez, Riel Lomadilla, and Viveika Ravanes.
- [Abot Kamay Na Pangarap | TV | GMA Entertainment](/entertainment/tv/abot_kamay_na_pangarap/): This September 2022, GMA-7 offers the most inspiring drama on Philippine television with 'Abot Kamay Na Pangarap'. The new drama series stars seasoned actress Carmina Villarroel and one of the fastest-rising Kapuso stars Jillian Ward. 'Abot Kamay Na Pangarap' tells the life story of an illiterate mother named Lyneth (Carmina Villarroel) and her intelligent daughter and youngest neuro surgeon in the Philippines named Analyn (Jillian Ward). Aside from the two actresses, the new Kapuso serye also stars Richard Yap who will play the role of Robert Tanyag, a passionate doctor. What is the true connection of Robert to Lyneth and Analyn? The story of this heartwarming series progresses as the two help and support each other in every struggle that comes their way. Will they be able to reach their goals and dreams through their amazing mother-daughter tandem? Watch out for another afternoon serye that will inspire you to be patient and to not stop in pursuing your dreams for yourself.
